// diagnostic

E3205

Overlay `{name}` disagrees with the generated binding.

What

Overlay `{name}` disagrees with the generated binding.

Why

User `#Import c.{lib}: module` may override bindgen symbols, but the Jet signature must stay compatible when replacing.

Fix

Match the generated signature, or rename your overlay function.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3205: tests/ui/cffi_e3205/stderr.

Error [jet.OverlayBindingConflict]: Overlay `add` disagrees with the generated binding
  --> tests/ui/cffi_e3205/run.jet:4:5
    |
  4 |     add: fn(a: Int) -> Int = "demo_add"
    |     ^^^
 Why: User `#Import c.demo: module` may override bindgen symbols, but the signature must stay compatible when replacing
 Fix: Match the generated signature, or rename your overlay function
